title: Car Growth Policy's Impact on E-commerce Industry and Commercial Motorcycles
what_it_is: Car Growth Policy's Impact on E-commerce Industry and Commercial Motorcycles

sections.label: Zero car growth and e-commerce
sections.summary: The Ministry maintains the 0.25% growth rate for Category C commercial vehicles and keeps Category D separate for motorcycles, saying splitting it would cause price volatility.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Transport with the recent announcement of zero growth in cars and motorcycles by February 2018 (a) how will the Ministry ensure that this policy does not adversely impact the e-commerce industry; and (b) whether the Ministry will consider a separate COE category for commercial motorcycles.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: However, we have maintained the existing 0.25% VGR for Category C commercial vehicles.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: This is to provide businesses with more time to improve the efficiency of their operations.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The current COE system sets aside Category D as a separate category for motorcycles so that motorcycle buyers need not compete with other vehicle buyers for COEs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Splitting Category D further would result in a smaller quota in each sub-category, which may lead to more volatility in prices.

sections.label: E-commerce, roads and urban logistics
sections.summary: The Ministry cites roads using 12% of land, keeps the 0.25% Category C growth rate, and notes a 2016 Urban Logistics Task Force and a federated locker network.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Yes, indeed, we do take into consideration some of these e-commerce businesses that are occurring in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: However, as the Member may know, today, 12% of Singapore's total land is already taken up by roads.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: As I have mentioned in my reply, we are maintaining the existing 0.25% vehicle growth rate for Category C commercial vehicles to provide businesses with more time to improve the efficiency of their operations.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: I am also glad to inform the Member that an interagency Urban Logistics Task Force comprising various agencies was convened in 2016 with the objective of facilitating the development of a more efficient urban logistics system which also reduces vehicle movements on the roads.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Other ongoing work streams also include the development of a federated locker network to improve the distribution of goods from businesses to end consumers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: So, I do take the recommendation from the Member and we will review the vehicle growth rate in time.
